description: CMS Plan Benefit Package (PBP) service categories to Benefit Plan Standard benefits, for scripts/from-pbp.js. One row per BPS benefit the importer writes: the PBP category code (as used in the Section C out-of-network and point-of-service groups and the Section D category lists), the B file and columns it reads, and a canonical_key from vocabularies/canonical-benefits.json or null. A category maps only when the PBP category clearly is the canonical service; there is no nearest fit (the CARIN crosswalk rule). canonical_key null means the benefit is still written, carried by service_name and pbp_code, and listed in docs/specs/pbp-importer.md section 9.1. See docs/specs/pbp-importer.md section 5.
source: PBP_Benefits_2027_dictionary.xlsx and the CY 2027 PBP Benefits files (https://www.cms.gov/files/zip/pbp-benefits-2027.zip): column names verbatim, lowercased as the importer reads them.
scope: The workgroup MVP: primary care, specialist, inpatient hospital, outpatient hospital (outpatient hospital services, observation, ambulatory surgical center), emergency, urgently needed services, ambulance, diagnostic tests, lab and imaging, physical and speech therapy, occupational therapy, services with visit limits (routine chiropractic, routine foot care, acupuncture, routine hearing and eye exams, with their Medicare-covered rows), and hearing aids.

field_guide.pbp_code: The service category code as the file writes it in category lists (pbp_c_oon_mc_bendesc_cats, pbp_c_oon_nmc_bendesc_cats, pbp_c_pos_*_subcats, pbp_d_*_cats).
field_guide.medicare_covered: true: a Medicare-covered category (coverage_basis medicare_covered, always covered). false: a supplemental category, offered when offered.yn is 1 and offered.ehc has a 1 at offered.position.
field_guide.offered.when_not_chosen: not_covered: write covered false on every network tier when the plan does not offer it. skip: write nothing. skip_unless_excluded: covered false only when offered.yn is 2.
field_guide.copay, coins: yn: the "Is there a copayment / coinsurance?" column (1 Yes, 2 No, 3 Yes with a min & max). ehc and position: the position string that says which services of the category carry it. min, max: the minimum and maximum columns. basis: written only where the dictionary title states it.
field_guide.service_deductible: The category-level "Is there a deductible?" column and its amount, written as a cost_shares step of type deductible. shared: the column covers more than this benefit.
field_guide.limits: quantity: lim (1 unlimited, 2 limited), num, per (periodicity code), per_d. dollars: the maximum plan benefit coverage columns; via: when type_col holds via.when, the amount is read from the via columns and both benefits carry via.shared_limit_id (hearing aids covered under the 18a maximum); shared_when: the same shared_limit_id on the 18a benefit.
field_guide.quote: Columns with no BPS field, quoted verbatim in the benefit source_references when not blank.
field_guide.in_network_only_note: true: on a plan with an OUT or POS tier and no group listing the category, the in-network row notes that the file prices it once (decision 5).
